title: Gravity
info: Gravity is a pull between things that have mass.
Earth's gravity keeps you on the ground and keeps the Moon in orbit.
More mass means a stronger pull. Being farther away makes the pull weaker.
The Moon's gravity is the main reason ocean tides rise and fall.
